verdict.rationale: Bolna documents an official CLI, a single Go binary that manages agents, calls, phone numbers and batches from the terminal with no dashboard required. It also documents an API-driven path for placing calls and running multi-step workflows, which together support headless automation. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD usage guidance (non-interactive auth via env vars, pipeline examples), machine-readable output documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
